g.text: Purpose: looping combat music for the "Candle Prototype Arena" top-
down wave-defense prototype (NIGHT-001). Style: dark synth pulse,
tense but minimal; 100-110 BPM; low-pass filtered layers that can
loop seamlessly. Length: 60-90 seconds, seamless loop (no
intro/outro fade). Format: OGG (Unity streaming), stereo, 48 kHz,
-16 LUFS integrated. Constraints: no vocals, no sudden key changes
mid-loop; must sit under frequent gunshots and UI beeps; melody
sparse. Technical: deliver as loopable OGG; if WAV provided, cut at
a bar boundary with no reverb tail. Reference scene: night phase of
a top-down arena defense; enemies entering from four gates; player
kiting in the middle. prototype_only: placeholder until reviewed.
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
